title: tier-2 shipped code: texture descriptor builder against FUN_142e2d900 (0x142e2d900)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/texture.rs, built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the texture_descriptor entry.

Oracle is FUN_142e2d900 at exe 0x142e2d900 (v2b 0x7ff7c7b4d900): object * (object *out, ushort *header). It reads the 0x20-byte header at +0..+0x13 and assembles the descriptor qword at out+0 and the flags dword at out+8. The probe parses the same header with the shipped TextureHeader::parse and writes descriptor() and object_flags() into the same 16-byte out.

The fixture keeps every header inside the loader's accepted set (format <= 0x71, mip <= 0x10, width/height nonzero, payload_count < 5, base_mips <= mip_count) because the probe calls the shipped parse, which applies the same checks in the same order.

state: 0x20 bytes at exe 0x1442a36d0 (v2b 0x7ff7c8fc36d0) covers the builder's process counters DAT_1442a36d8/e0/e8. The fixture pins total_size to 0, so DAT_1442a36d8 += total_size is a no-op; param_1[10] is set to 0 before the other two adds. The state channel therefore proves the builder's global writes stay within the declared counters and change nothing.

The out object is 16 bytes on purpose. The builder also writes -1 sentinels, the header pointers and total_size past +0x10; those are object bookkeeping, not the descriptor parsing this unit proves. The header pointee is placed at arena+0x100 so those writes cannot overlap it.

byte +0x07 is pinned to 0. The builder's flags are `flags | 0x100000` only; the loader (0x141dacf00) adds 0x4000 when +0x07 == 1, and that loader rule is read and unit-tested but is not this builder's write.
The builder's payload_count > 1 branch reads DAT_1442a36e8; the fixture includes payload 2..4 so both counter branches run.
acknowledgedGaps: The builder's output fields past +0x10 (the -1 sentinels, header/header+0x20 pointers, total_size at +0x40, usage/format bytes at +0x60) are not compared: their pointer values differ between the guest arena and the probe's host buffers, and total_size is pinned to zero for the counter channel. The descriptor qword and flags dword, which are the parsing result, are compared.
